title: Frostfang the Ice Wyrm
story: Frostfang the Ice Wyrm slithers down from the glacier, freezing 6 villages solid every single day! There are 42 villages in the Green Valley, and Mr 6's ride through the mountain pass will take 3 days.
question: How many villages can Mr 6 still save when he arrives?
hint: First: how many villages does Frostfang freeze in 3 days, at 6 per day? Subtract that from 42.
victory: Mr 6 arrives to find 24 villages still warm — and a plan already forming. He lures Frostfang into the hot springs, where the wyrm melts into a very confused, very happy pond serpent. The frozen villages thaw by spring!
solution: Frostfang freezes 6 villages a day for 3 days: 6 x 3 = 18 villages frozen.
praise: Multiplying 6 by 3 days shows you understood the wyrm's pace — the step left was subtracting from the 42 villages.
